text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Here is the menu for tomorrow's joint 
training. I'm thinking of increasing the 
load to build up our power.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
"Well done—it is well—thought out. But in 
my opinion— you could raise it—a bit more. 
The upper limit—of the workload."

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"...Do you really think so? Analyzing my 
rate of growth up to this point, I feel I 
have not yet reached that stage."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
—There is... no need to worry. You are... 
strong. You have... room to grow.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Ah... you flatter me. Indeed, one must 
constantly strive to surpass their own 
limits.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
"So—if it is you— you will assess your own 
condition—and potential—each time... and 
reach it. —Even further beyond."

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"...Gh, u-um...! I appreciate the 
compliments, but aren't you exaggerating a 
bit much...?!"

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"No! That's not it at all...! It's just... 
maybe you're praising me a bit too much, 
or so I thought—"

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
This is no flattery. —It is from the 
heart. ...You are—magnificent. So――………….

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
No, um... the pleasure is mine... —Thank 
you, very much.
